title: Gatefold run-comparison result
description: Machine-readable claim collection emitted by gatefold compare-runs --format json. Version 5 describes a two-run-directory A -> B comparison: evidence references name which document of which run they resolve against (trace, artifact manifest, or verified patch bytes), and per-run metadata lives in the inputs map.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this result schema. Additive changes keep the version; structural changes bump it.

source.description: Identifies this result as a two-run-directory comparison.

inputs.description: Descriptors of the two validated yuurei run directories, keyed by their role in the comparison.

label.description: The input argument as supplied, or '<stdin>'.

schemaVersion.description: The trace's schema_version compatibility token, compared for equality (currently '0.3').

yuureiVersion.description: yuurei_version of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

runtimeVersion.description: runtime.version of the trace; null is preserved as null.

modelResolved.description: model.resolved of the trace; null means the effective model was not observed.

modelResolvedReason.description: model.resolved_reason of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

requestedCellDigest.description: requested_cell.digest of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

requestedCellInputsVersion.description: requested_cell.inputs_version of the trace; absent when the trace does not carry it.

executionOptions.description: The trace's execution_options value recorded verbatim; absent when the trace does not carry it.

definition.description: The trace's definition value recorded verbatim ({ run: string | null, cli_overrides: string[] }); absent when the trace does not carry it.

artifactEntry.description: One artifact manifest entry preserved verbatim plus Gatefold's verification outcome.

path.description: The manifest-recorded path, relative to the run directory. Treated as data, never as an access instruction.

digest.description: The manifest-recorded digest of the stored bytes (sha256:<hex> when verifiable).

truncated.description: Present and true only when the manifest marks the stored bytes as cut at yuurei's size cap. The digest covers the stored (cut) bytes.

bytes.description: Stored byte count when the file was examined; absent when the artifact was not read.

state.description: Verification outcome: the stored bytes hash to the recorded digest (verified, or verified-truncated when also marked truncated), they do not (digest-mismatch), no readable file exists at the path (missing), or the bytes were not read or not verifiable in this milestone (unverified).

runInput.description: Descriptor of one loaded yuurei run directory: the supplied label, the trace descriptor, the patch summary state, and the manifest facts.

label.description: The run directory argument as supplied.

patchState.description: The state of the run's patch.diff: the manifest entry's state when listed, 'malformed' when verified bytes violate the patch grammar, or 'not-recorded' when the manifest lists no patch entry.

claim.description: A single descriptive statement about the comparison. Never a judgement of quality.

ruleId.description: Stable identifier of the rule that produced this claim.

evidence.description: References into the two runs' documents that support the claim. A claim without evidence is invalid.

confidence.description: Certainty that the evidence supports the claim. 1 = fully supported. Not a harness quality score.

source.description: Which document of which run the reference resolves against: the run's trace.json, its artifacts.json, or its verified patch.diff bytes.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the document named by source. For the *Patch sources it is the manifest pointer of the run's patch.diff entry, binding the citation to the manifest record. The empty string references the whole document.

digest.description: Patch evidence only: the manifest-recorded digest of the stored patch bytes the range locates into.

path.description: Patch evidence only: the generated-file path whose block the range locates inside the stored patch bytes.

lines.description: Patch evidence only: an inclusive 1-based line range inside the stored patch bytes.

bytes.description: Patch evidence only: a half-open 0-based byte range inside the stored patch bytes.

elementId.description: Identifier of the referenced element, verbatim from the input document. Unused by trace and run claims.

note.description: Optional human-readable clarification of what the reference shows, for example that a patch records no block for a path.

range.description: An inclusive 1-based line range or a half-open 0-based byte range into stored patch bytes.

provenance.description: Per-run metadata (directory labels, trace descriptors, manifest facts) lives in the top-level inputs map because a comparison claim can cite both runs.

transform.description: Names of the transformations applied between the raw inputs and this claim, in application order. Empty when the claim reads the inputs directly.
